# Pull Request

**By submitting this pull request, I confirm that:**
*(Tick each box that applies, e.g. `[x]`.)*

- [ ] I've read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/tronyx/tronitor/blob/develop/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and this whole template.
- [ ] This pull request makes one change.

- [ ] My change works on Python 3.11 and doesn't add a required package.
